void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes_text(string[] choices, string value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

bool includes_id(nat[] choices, nat value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

bool[] flags(nat size)
    return [for i := (0:<nat(size))[] then false]

class TextPair(string head, string tail)

TextPair cut_once(string text, separator := " ")
    match text.find(separator)
        nat at
            return TextPair(text[:<at], text[at + #separator:])
        none
            return TextPair(text, "")

class ExprNode(string kind, text := "", value := 0, nat[] operands := [])
class Expression(nat root := 0, ExprNode[] nodes := [])

class ExpressionReader(string source)
    string[] lexemes := []
    nat offset := 0
    ExprNode[] pool := []

    void .tokenize()
        nat at := 0
        while at < #source
            character := source[at]
            if character == " "
                at += 1
                continue
            start := at
            if "0123456789".contains(character)
                while at < #source and "0123456789".contains(source[at])
                    at += 1
            elif "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_".contains(character)
                while at < #source and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789".contains(source[at])
                    at += 1
            else
                at += 1
                if at < #source and includes_text(["||", "&&", "==", "!=", "<=", ">="], source[start:at])
                    at += 1
            lexemes = lexemes.append(source[start:<at])

    string peek()
        return if offset < #lexemes then lexemes[offset] else ""

    string .take_token()
        result := lexemes[offset]
        offset += 1
        return result

    nat .add_node(ExprNode node)
        result := #pool
        pool = pool.append(node)
        return result

    nat .parse_level(nat level := 0)
        if level == 5
            return .parse_unary()
        string[][] levels := [["||"], ["&&"], ["==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], ["+", "-"], ["*", "/", "%"]]
        nat left := .parse_level(level + 1)
        while includes_text(levels[level], peek())
            string op := .take_token()
            nat right := .parse_level(level + 1)
            left = .add_node(ExprNode("binary", op, operands = [left, right]))
        return left

    nat .parse_unary()
        string token := .take_token()
        if token == "!" or token == "-"
            nat operand := .parse_unary()
            return .add_node(ExprNode("unary", token, operands = [operand]))
        if token == "("
            nat result := .parse_level()
            .take_token()
            return result
        if "0123456789".contains(token[0])
            return .add_node(ExprNode("number", value = int(token)))
        if token == "in"
            .take_token()
            string name := .take_token()
            .take_token()
            return .add_node(ExprNode("state", name))
        return .add_node(ExprNode(if token == "_data" then "data" else "variable", token))

    Expression .read()
        .tokenize()
        nat root := .parse_level()
        return Expression(root, pool)

Expression read_expression(string text)
    reader := ExpressionReader(text)
    return .reader.read()

class Action(string kind, name := "", nat delay := 0, text := "", expression := Expression())
class ActionList(Action[] items := [])

ActionList read_actions(string text)
    Action[] result := []
    if text == ""
        return ActionList()
    for item := text.split("; ")[]
        first := cut_once(item)
        word := first.head
        rest := first.tail
        if word == "raise"
            parts := cut_once(rest)
            expr := if parts.tail == "" then Expression() else read_expression(parts.tail)
            result = result.append(Action("raise", parts.head, expression = expr))
        elif word == "send"
            event_part := cut_once(rest)
            delay_part := cut_once(event_part.tail)
            expr := if delay_part.tail == "" then Expression() else read_expression(delay_part.tail)
            result = result.append(Action("send", event_part.head, nat(delay_part.head), expression = expr))
        elif word == "cancel"
            result = result.append(Action("cancel", rest))
        elif word == "log"
            if rest.starts_with(DQ)
                nat closing := 0
                match rest[1:].find(DQ)
                    nat found
                        closing = found + 1
                    none
                        void
                tail := if closing + 1 < #rest then rest[closing + 2:] else ""
                expr := if tail == "" then Expression() else read_expression(tail)
                result = result.append(Action("log", text = rest[1:<closing], expression = expr))
            else
                result = result.append(Action("log", expression = read_expression(rest)))
        else
            result = result.append(Action("assign", word, expression = read_expression(rest[2:])))
    return ActionList(result)

class OnParts(string source_name, string trigger_kind, string descriptors, nat delay, string guard_text, string target_name, bool local_target, string action_text)

OnParts read_transition(string text)
    first := cut_once(text[3:])
    trigger := cut_once(first.tail)
    rest := trigger.tail
    trigger_kind := "event"
    nat delay := 0
    if trigger.head == "always"
        trigger_kind = "always"
    elif trigger.head == "after"
        trigger_kind = "timer"
        number := cut_once(rest)
        delay = nat(number.head)
        rest = number.tail
    guard_text := ""
    if rest.starts_with("[")
        nat closing := 0
        match rest.find("]")
            nat found
                closing = found
            none
                void
        guard_text = rest[1:<closing]
        rest = if closing + 1 < #rest then rest[closing + 2:] else ""
    target_name := ""
    local_target := false
    if rest.starts_with("-> ") or rest.starts_with("~> ")
        local_target = rest.starts_with("~>")
        target := cut_once(rest[3:])
        target_name = target.head
        rest = target.tail
    action_text := if rest.starts_with("/ ") then rest[2:] else ""
    return OnParts(first.head, trigger_kind, trigger.head, delay, guard_text, target_name, local_target, action_text)

class State(string name, string kind, int parent, nat depth, initial_name := "", default_name := "", deep_history := false)
    nat[] children := []
    ActionList[] entries := []
    ActionList[] exits := []
    nat[] transition_ids := []

class Transition(nat source_id, string trigger_kind, string[] descriptors, nat delay, Expression guard, int target_id, bool local_target, ActionList actions)
class DefinitionLine(nat number, string text)
class ChartModel()
    states := [State("", "root", -1, 0)]
    by_name := map<string, nat>()
    initial_variables := map<string, int>()
    Transition[] transitions := []
    nat[] document_order := []

int state_index(ChartModel chart, string name)
    match chart.by_name.get(name)
        nat index
            return int(index)
        none
            return -1

nat[] child_states(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    nat[] result := []
    for child := chart.states[state_id].children[]
        if chart.states[child].kind != "history"
            result = result.append(child)
    return result

bool is_compound(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    return state_id == 0 or (chart.states[state_id].kind == "state" and #child_states(chart, state_id) > 0)

bool is_parallel(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    return chart.states[state_id].kind == "parallel" and #child_states(chart, state_id) > 0

bool is_atomic(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    return chart.states[state_id].kind != "history" and #child_states(chart, state_id) == 0

bool is_descendant(ChartModel chart, nat state_id, nat ancestor_id)
    current := chart.states[state_id].parent
    while current >= 0
        if current == int(ancestor_id)
            return true
        current = chart.states[current].parent
    return false

nat initial_id(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    name := chart.states[state_id].initial_name
    return if name == "" then child_states(chart, state_id)[0] else nat(state_index(chart, name))

nat default_id(ChartModel chart, nat state_id)
    name := chart.states[state_id].default_name
    return if name == "" then initial_id(chart, nat(chart.states[state_id].parent)) else nat(state_index(chart, name))

string check_expression_node(ChartModel chart, Expression expr, nat node_id)
    node := expr.nodes[node_id]
    if node.kind == "variable"
        match chart.initial_variables.get(node.text)
            int value
                void
            none
                return "unknown variable " + node.text
    if node.kind == "state" and state_index(chart, node.text) < 0
        return "unknown state " + node.text
    for child := node.operands[]
        failure := check_expression_node(chart, expr, child)
        if failure != ""
            return failure
    return ""

string check_expression(ChartModel chart, Expression expr)
    return if #expr.nodes == 0 then "" else check_expression_node(chart, expr, expr.root)

string check_actions(ChartModel chart, ActionList list)
    for action := list.items[]
        if action.kind == "assign"
            match chart.initial_variables.get(action.name)
                int value
                    void
                none
                    return "unknown variable " + action.name
        failure := check_expression(chart, action.expression)
        if failure != ""
            return failure
    return ""

class Builder(DefinitionLine[] lines)
    model := ChartModel()
    string[] failures := [for i := (nat(0):<#lines)[] then ""]
    nat[] state_for_line := [for i := (nat(0):<#lines)[] then 0]

    void .first_phase()
        for: row < #lines
            words := lines[row].text.split(" ")
            kind := words[0]
            if includes_text(["state", "parallel", "final", "history"], kind)
                name := words[1]
                parent_name := ""
                init := ""
                fallback := ""
                deep := false
                if kind == "state"
                    nat at := 2
                    if #words > 2 and words[2] != "initial"
                        parent_name = words[2]
                        at = 3
                    if at < #words
                        init = words[at + 1]
                elif kind == "parallel"
                    if #words == 3
                        parent_name = words[2]
                else
                    parent_name = words[2]
                    if kind == "history"
                        deep = words[3] == "deep"
                        if #words == 5
                            fallback = words[4]
                parent_index := if parent_name == "" then 0 else state_index(model, parent_name)
                if state_index(model, name) >= 0
                    failures[row] = "duplicate state " + name
                elif parent_index < 0
                    failures[row] = "unknown state " + parent_name
                elif includes_text(["final", "history"], model.states[parent_index].kind)
                    failures[row] = parent_name + " cannot have children"
                else
                    index := #model.states
                    state_for_line[row] = index
                    .model.by_name.set(name, index)
                    model.states = model.states.append(State(name, kind, parent_index, model.states[parent_index].depth + 1, init, fallback, deep))
                    model.states[parent_index].children = model.states[parent_index].children.append(index)
            elif kind == "var"
                match model.initial_variables.get(words[1])
                    int value
                        failures[row] = "duplicate variable " + words[1]
                    none
                        .model.initial_variables.set(words[1], int(words[2]))

    void .second_phase()
        for: row < #lines
            if failures[row] != ""
                continue
            text := lines[row].text
            words := text.split(" ")
            kind := words[0]
            failure := ""
            if includes_text(["state", "final", "history"], kind)
                index := state_for_line[row]
                State node := model.states[index]
                if kind == "state" and node.initial_name != ""
                    child := state_index(model, node.initial_name)
                    if child < 0
                        failure = "unknown state " + node.initial_name
                    elif model.states[child].parent != int(index) or model.states[child].kind == "history"
                        failure = node.initial_name + " is not a child of " + node.name
                elif kind == "final" or kind == "history"
                    parent_id := nat(node.parent)
                    if model.states[parent_id].kind != "state" or #child_states(model, parent_id) == 0
                        failure = node.name + " needs a compound parent"
                    elif kind == "history" and node.default_name != ""
                        target := state_index(model, node.default_name)
                        if target < 0
                            failure = "unknown state " + node.default_name
                        elif not is_descendant(model, nat(target), parent_id) or model.states[target].kind == "history"
                            failure = node.default_name + " is not a descendant of " + model.states[parent_id].name
            elif kind == "entry" or kind == "exit"
                index := state_index(model, words[1])
                if index < 0
                    failure = "unknown state " + words[1]
                elif model.states[index].kind == "history"
                    failure = words[1] + " cannot have actions"
                else
                    list := read_actions(cut_once(text, " / ").tail)
                    failure = check_actions(model, list)
                    if failure == ""
                        if kind == "entry"
                            model.states[index].entries = model.states[index].entries.append(list)
                        else
                            model.states[index].exits = model.states[index].exits.append(list)
            elif kind == "on"
                parts := read_transition(text)
                index := state_index(model, parts.source_name)
                if index < 0
                    failure = "unknown state " + parts.source_name
                elif includes_text(["final", "history"], model.states[index].kind)
                    failure = parts.source_name + " cannot have transitions"
                else
                    guard := if parts.guard_text == "" then Expression() else read_expression(parts.guard_text)
                    failure = check_expression(model, guard)
                    target := if parts.target_name == "" then -1 else state_index(model, parts.target_name)
                    if failure == "" and parts.target_name != "" and target < 0
                        failure = "unknown state " + parts.target_name
                    list := read_actions(parts.action_text)
                    if failure == ""
                        failure = check_actions(model, list)
                    if failure == ""
                        transition_index := #model.transitions
                        model.transitions = model.transitions.append(Transition(nat(index), parts.trigger_kind, parts.descriptors.split("|"), parts.delay, guard, target, parts.local_target, list))
                        model.states[index].transition_ids = model.states[index].transition_ids.append(transition_index)
            failures[row] = failure

    void .visit(nat state_id)
        model.document_order = model.document_order.append(state_id)
        for child := model.states[state_id].children[]
            .visit(child)

    ChartModel .build()
        .first_phase()
        .second_phase()
        for child := model.states[0].children[]
            .visit(child)
        return model

class Event(name := "", value := 0)
class Reservation(int due, nat creation, transition_id := -1, held_event := Event())
class HistoryValue(recorded := false, nat[] ids := [])

string state_names(ChartModel chart, nat[] ids)
    return if #ids == 0 then "-" else [for id := ids[] then chart.states[id].name].join(",")

nat[] ordered_ids(ChartModel chart, bool[] members, reverse := false)
    nat[] result := []
    for id := chart.document_order[]
        if members[id]
            result = result.append(id)
    return if reverse then result[::-1] else result

string timer_name(ChartModel chart, nat transition_id)
    item := chart.transitions[transition_id]
    return "after({item.delay})@" + chart.states[item.source_id].name

string event_name(Event item)
    return item.name + (if item.value == 0 then "" else "={item.value}")

bool[] close_entries(ChartModel chart, bool[] seeds)
    result := seeds
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for id := chart.document_order[]
            if not result[id]
                continue
            children := child_states(chart, id)
            nat[] extra := []
            if is_parallel(chart, id)
                extra = children
            elif is_compound(chart, id)
                has_child := false
                for child := children[]
                    if result[child]
                        has_child = true
                if not has_child
                    extra = [initial_id(chart, id)]
            for child := extra[]
                if not result[child]
                    result[child] = true
                    changed = true
    return result

class Engine(ChartModel chart)
    bool[] configuration := flags(#chart.states)
    map<string, int> values := chart.initial_variables
    data_value := 0
    Event[] queue := []
    Reservation[] reservations := []
    nat serial_counter := 0
    HistoryValue[] history_values := [for i := (nat(0):<#chart.states)[] then HistoryValue()]
    clock := 0
    trace_enabled := false
    stopped := false
    nat macro_count := 0
    nat micro_count := 0
    nat within_count := 0
    nat[] entry_counts := [for i := (nat(0):<#chart.states)[] then 0]
    nat[] transition_counts := [for i := (nat(0):<#chart.states)[] then 0]
    int[] dwell_values := [for i := (nat(0):<#chart.states)[] then 0]
    int[] entry_times := [for i := (nat(0):<#chart.states)[] then 0]

    int | error evaluate_node(Expression expr, nat node_id)
        node := expr.nodes[node_id]
        if node.kind == "number"
            return node.value
        if node.kind == "variable"
            match values.get(node.text)
                int value
                    return value
                none
                    return error("unknown variable")
        if node.kind == "data"
            return data_value
        if node.kind == "state"
            return if configuration[state_index(chart, node.text)] then 1 else 0
        int a := try evaluate_node(expr, node.operands[0])
        if node.kind == "unary"
            return if node.text == "!" then (if a == 0 then 1 else 0) else -a
        op := node.text
        if op == "&&" and a == 0
            return 0
        if op == "||" and a != 0
            return 1
        int b := try evaluate_node(expr, node.operands[1])
        if op == "&&" or op == "||"
            return if b != 0 then 1 else 0
        if op == "/" or op == "%"
            if b == 0
                return error("division by zero")
            return if op == "/" then a / b else a % b
        if op == "+"
            return a + b
        if op == "-"
            return a - b
        if op == "*"
            return a * b
        result := if op == "==" then a == b else (if op == "!=" then a != b else (if op == "<" then a < b else (if op == "<=" then a <= b else (if op == ">" then a > b else a >= b))))
        return if result then 1 else 0

    int | error evaluate_expression(Expression expr)
        return evaluate_node(expr, expr.root)

    void .add_reservation(nat delay, transition_id := -1, held := Event())
        serial_counter += 1
        reservations = reservations.append(Reservation(clock + int(delay), serial_counter, transition_id, held))

    void .perform_actions(ActionList list)
        for item := list.items[]
            value := 0
            if #item.expression.nodes > 0
                match evaluate_expression(item.expression)
                    int evaluated
                        value = evaluated
                    error failure
                        queue = queue.append(Event("error.execution"))
                        return
            if item.kind == "assign"
                .values.set(item.name, value)
            elif item.kind == "raise"
                queue = queue.append(Event(item.name, value))
            elif item.kind == "send"
                .add_reservation(item.delay, held = Event(item.name, value))
            elif item.kind == "cancel"
                Reservation[] kept := []
                for booking := reservations[]
                    if booking.transition_id >= 0 or booking.held_event.name != item.name
                        kept = kept.append(booking)
                reservations = kept
            elif item.kind == "log"
                emit(item.text + (if #item.expression.nodes == 0 then "" else string(value)))

    bool complete_state(nat state_id)
        children := child_states(chart, state_id)
        if is_compound(chart, state_id)
            for child := children[]
                if chart.states[child].kind == "final" and configuration[child]
                    return true
        elif is_parallel(chart, state_id)
            for child := children[]
                if not complete_state(child)
                    return false
            return true
        return false

    void .enter_states(bool[] entering)
        for state_id := chart.document_order[]
            if not entering[state_id]
                continue
            item := chart.states[state_id]
            configuration[state_id] = true
            entry_counts[state_id] += 1
            entry_times[state_id] = clock
            for transition_id := item.transition_ids[]
                branch := chart.transitions[transition_id]
                if branch.trigger_kind == "timer"
                    .add_reservation(branch.delay, int(transition_id))
            for list := item.entries[]
                .perform_actions(list)
            if item.kind == "final"
                parent_id := nat(item.parent)
                queue = queue.append(Event("done.state." + chart.states[parent_id].name))
                grandparent := chart.states[parent_id].parent
                if grandparent >= 0 and is_parallel(chart, nat(grandparent))
                    all_complete := true
                    for child := child_states(chart, nat(grandparent))[]
                        if not complete_state(child)
                            all_complete = false
                    if all_complete
                        queue = queue.append(Event("done.state." + chart.states[grandparent].name))

    nat[] effective_targets(Transition item)
        if item.target_id < 0
            return []
        target := nat(item.target_id)
        if chart.states[target].kind != "history"
            return [target]
        return if history_values[target].recorded then history_values[target].ids else [default_id(chart, target)]

    int transition_scope(Transition item)
        if item.target_id < 0
            return -1
        nat[] targets := effective_targets(item)
        source_encloses := true
        for target := targets[]
            if not is_descendant(chart, target, item.source_id)
                source_encloses = false
        if item.local_target and is_compound(chart, item.source_id) and source_encloses
            return int(item.source_id)
        current := chart.states[item.source_id].parent
        while current >= 0
            encloses := true
            for target := targets[]
                if not is_descendant(chart, target, nat(current))
                    encloses = false
            if is_compound(chart, nat(current)) and encloses
                return current
            current = chart.states[current].parent
        return -1

    bool[] exits_for(Transition item)
        result := flags(#chart.states)
        int bound := transition_scope(item)
        if bound >= 0
            for id := chart.document_order[]
                result[id] = configuration[id] and is_descendant(chart, id, nat(bound))
        return result

    bool matches_trigger(nat transition_id, string trigger_kind, Event item, int timer_id)
        branch := chart.transitions[transition_id]
        if trigger_kind == "always"
            return branch.trigger_kind == "always"
        if trigger_kind == "timer"
            return int(transition_id) == timer_id
        if branch.trigger_kind != "event"
            return false
        for descriptor := branch.descriptors[]
            if descriptor == "*" or descriptor == item.name or item.name.starts_with(descriptor + ".")
                return true
        return false

    bool .guard_accepts(Transition item)
        if #item.guard.nodes == 0
            return true
        match evaluate_expression(item.guard)
            int value
                return value != 0
            error failure
                queue = queue.append(Event("error.execution"))
                return false

    nat[] .select_transitions(string trigger_kind, item := Event(), timer_id := -1)
        nat[] candidates := []
        for atomic_id := chart.document_order[]
            if not configuration[atomic_id] or not is_atomic(chart, atomic_id)
                continue
            current := atomic_id
            found := -1
            while current != 0 and found < 0
                for transition_id := chart.states[current].transition_ids[]
                    if matches_trigger(transition_id, trigger_kind, item, timer_id)
                        if .guard_accepts(chart.transitions[transition_id])
                            found = int(transition_id)
                            break
                current = nat(chart.states[current].parent)
            if found >= 0 and not includes_id(candidates, nat(found))
                candidates = candidates.append(nat(found))
        nat[] kept := []
        exiting := flags(#chart.states)
        for transition_id := candidates[]
            bool[] proposed := exits_for(chart.transitions[transition_id])
            conflict := false
            for id := chart.document_order[]
                if exiting[id] and proposed[id]
                    conflict = true
            if not conflict
                kept = kept.append(transition_id)
                for id := chart.document_order[]
                    exiting[id] = exiting[id] or proposed[id]
        return kept

    void .micro_step(nat[] selected, string display)
        if within_count == 1000
            emit("LIVELOCK t={clock}")
            stopped = true
            return
        within_count += 1
        micro_count += 1
        int[] scopes := [for transition_id := selected[] then transition_scope(chart.transitions[transition_id])]
        exiting := flags(#chart.states)
        for bound := scopes[]
            if bound >= 0
                for id := chart.document_order[]
                    exiting[id] = exiting[id] or (configuration[id] and is_descendant(chart, id, nat(bound)))
        for state_id := chart.document_order[]
            if not exiting[state_id]
                continue
            for child := chart.states[state_id].children[]
                item := chart.states[child]
                if item.kind != "history"
                    continue
                nat[] remembered := []
                for id := chart.document_order[]
                    if configuration[id]
                        belongs := if item.deep_history then is_atomic(chart, id) and is_descendant(chart, id, state_id) else chart.states[id].parent == int(state_id)
                        if belongs
                            remembered = remembered.append(id)
                history_values[child] = HistoryValue(true, remembered)
        seeds := flags(#chart.states)
        for: i < #selected
            branch := chart.transitions[selected[i]]
            if branch.target_id < 0
                continue
            bound := scopes[i]
            for target := effective_targets(branch)[]
                seeds[target] = true
                current := chart.states[target].parent
                while current != bound
                    seeds[current] = true
                    current = chart.states[current].parent
        entering := close_entries(chart, seeds)
        if trace_enabled
            sources := [for transition_id := selected[] then chart.transitions[transition_id].source_id]
            emit("[t={clock}] " + display + " (" + state_names(chart, sources) + "): exit " + state_names(chart, ordered_ids(chart, exiting, true)) + "; enter " + state_names(chart, ordered_ids(chart, entering)))
        for state_id := chart.document_order[::-1][]
            if not exiting[state_id]
                continue
            for list := chart.states[state_id].exits[]
                .perform_actions(list)
            configuration[state_id] = false
            dwell_values[state_id] += clock - entry_times[state_id]
            Reservation[] kept := []
            for booking := reservations[]
                if booking.transition_id < 0 or chart.transitions[booking.transition_id].source_id != state_id
                    kept = kept.append(booking)
            reservations = kept
        for transition_id := selected[]
            branch := chart.transitions[transition_id]
            .perform_actions(branch.actions)
            transition_counts[branch.source_id] += 1
        .enter_states(entering)

    void .macro_step(string trigger_kind, item := Event(), timer_id := -1)
        macro_count += 1
        within_count = 0
        data_value = item.value
        if trigger_kind == "start"
            seeds := flags(#chart.states)
            seeds[initial_id(chart, 0)] = true
            .enter_states(close_entries(chart, seeds))
        else
            nat[] selected := .select_transitions(trigger_kind, item, timer_id)
            if #selected > 0
                .micro_step(selected, if trigger_kind == "timer" then timer_name(chart, nat(timer_id)) else event_name(item))
        while not stopped
            data_value = 0
            nat[] selected := .select_transitions("always")
            if #selected > 0
                .micro_step(selected, "always")
                continue
            if #queue == 0
                break
            next := queue[0]
            queue = queue[1:]
            data_value = next.value
            selected = .select_transitions("event", next)
            if #selected > 0
                .micro_step(selected, event_name(next))

    void write_dump()
        emit("dump t={clock}")
        for id := chart.document_order[]
            if configuration[id]
                emit(" " * (chart.states[id].depth * 2) + chart.states[id].name)
        for name := values.keys().sorted()[]
            match values.get(name)
                int value
                    emit("  var " + name + " = {value}")
                none
                    void
        for id := chart.document_order[]
            if history_values[id].recorded
                emit("  history " + chart.states[id].name + " = " + state_names(chart, history_values[id].ids))
        ordered := reservations
        for: i < #ordered
            j := i
            while j > 0 and (ordered[j].due < ordered[j - 1].due or (ordered[j].due == ordered[j - 1].due and ordered[j].creation < ordered[j - 1].creation))
                previous := ordered[j - 1]
                ordered[j - 1] = ordered[j]
                ordered[j] = previous
                j -= 1
        for booking := ordered[]
            if booking.transition_id < 0
                emit("  send {booking.due} " + booking.held_event.name + " {booking.held_event.value}")
            else
                emit("  timer {booking.due} " + timer_name(chart, nat(booking.transition_id)))

    void .script_line(string text)
        words := text.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        if command == "event"
            .macro_step("event", Event(words[1], if #words == 3 then int(words[2]) else 0))
        elif command == "tick"
            int finish := clock + int(words[1])
            while not stopped and #reservations > 0
                nat index := 0
                for: i < #reservations
                    if reservations[i].due < reservations[index].due or (reservations[i].due == reservations[index].due and reservations[i].creation < reservations[index].creation)
                        index = i
                booking := reservations[index]
                if booking.due > finish
                    break
                reservations = reservations[:<index].concat(reservations[index + 1:])
                clock = booking.due
                .macro_step(if booking.transition_id < 0 then "event" else "timer", booking.held_event, booking.transition_id)
            if not stopped
                clock = finish
        elif command == "set"
            match values.get(words[1])
                int old
                    .values.set(words[1], int(words[2]))
                none
                    emit("error: unknown variable " + words[1])
        elif command == "trace"
            trace_enabled = words[1] == "on"
        elif command == "dump"
            write_dump()
        elif command == "eval"
            original := text[5:]
            expr := read_expression(original)
            failure := check_expression(chart, expr)
            if failure != ""
                emit("error: " + failure)
            else
                data_value = 0
                match evaluate_expression(expr)
                    int value
                        emit(original + " -> {value}")
                    error evaluation_failure
                        emit("error: division by zero")

    void write_statistics()
        emit("end t={clock} macrosteps={macro_count} microsteps={micro_count}")
        for id := chart.document_order[]
            if chart.states[id].kind == "history"
                continue
            total := dwell_values[id] + (if configuration[id] then clock - entry_times[id] else 0)
            emit("  " + chart.states[id].name + " entered={entry_counts[id]} taken={transition_counts[id]} time={total}")

void warn_unreachable(ChartModel chart)
    reached := flags(#chart.states)
    reached[initial_id(chart, 0)] = true
    changed := true
    while changed
        before := reached
        for id := chart.document_order[]
            if not reached[id]
                continue
            parent_id := chart.states[id].parent
            if parent_id > 0
                reached[parent_id] = true
            if is_compound(chart, id)
                reached[initial_id(chart, id)] = true
            if is_parallel(chart, id)
                for child := child_states(chart, id)[]
                    reached[child] = true
            for transition_id := chart.states[id].transition_ids[]
                target := chart.transitions[transition_id].target_id
                if target >= 0
                    nat destination := if chart.states[target].kind == "history" then default_id(chart, nat(target)) else nat(target)
                    reached[destination] = true
        changed = reached != before
    for id := chart.document_order[]
        if chart.states[id].kind != "history" and not reached[id]
            emit("warning: unreachable state " + chart.states[id].name)

void run_chart(string name, DefinitionLine[] definitions, string[] scripts)
    emit("chart " + name)
    builder := Builder(definitions)
    chart := .builder.build()
    invalid := false
    for: row < #definitions
        if builder.failures[row] != ""
            invalid = true
            emit("error line {definitions[row].number}: " + builder.failures[row])
    if invalid
        return
    warn_unreachable(chart)
    engine := Engine(chart)
    .engine.macro_step("start")
    for text := scripts[]
        if engine.stopped
            break
        .engine.script_line(text)
    engine.write_statistics()

void read_charts()
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    count := nat(line)
    nat number := 1
    for: i < count
        scan(&line)
        number += 1
        name := line[6:]
        DefinitionLine[] definitions := []
        while true
            scan(&line)
            number += 1
            if line == "RUN"
                break
            definitions = definitions.append(DefinitionLine(number, line))
        string[] scripts := []
        while true
            scan(&line)
            number += 1
            if line == "END"
                break
            scripts = scripts.append(line)
        run_chart(name, definitions, scripts)

read_charts()
